stackDivergence.rationale: Original OUString.subView one/two-argument overloads return borrowed UTF16 storage with original range assertion order, no string allocation/copy/acquire, embedded-zero/surrogate preservation and original default remainder. Native Uint16Array.subarray adapts std::u16string_view with the same underlying buffer and offset. Existing genuine full SAL/OUString native caller observes every valid range over all65536 units and complete explicit inputs, original static literal views and source replacement while a copied owner keeps old storage live; the adjacent portable test replays every returned unit and initialized ownership/offset witness. Invalid native ranges are undefined in the public contract; checked-build assertion/order outcomes remain separate observations, mapped to Error rather than native termination. Caller must retain the real data owner and treat views as const. Native physical pointer lifetime/ABI/const enforcement, use after release, arbitrary malformed JS arguments and full upstream QA/getByName/type/exception/case consumers remain unverified. No additional string_view library or Calc-local string owner.
